title: Affiliate Application: ZenRows

payload.instructions: Navigate to https://www.zenrows.com/partners/apply, complete application form for ZenRows, and record status as done.

url_chain: zenrows.com/affiliate -> zenrows.com/partners/affiliates ('35% recurring revenue... Apply now') -> zenrows.com/partners/apply

zenrows.com/partners/apply is a native, no-password intake form (Name*, Last Name, Work Email*, Website or main profile URL*, 'How do you want to partner with us?'* dropdown listing Affiliate/Reseller/Creator/Technology/Solutions/Agency/Strategic, plus two checkboxes: an optional 'I agree to receive other communications from ZenRows' and a required 'I agree to allow ZenRows to store and process my personal data*'). No password field anywhere - squarely butler territory by the standing role split.

TECHNICAL BLOCKER: across 3 separate fresh browser tabs (499332320, 499332362, 499332365), every attempt to click into and type in the Name field triggered a reproducible renderer freeze (CDP 'Page.captureScreenshot' timing out after 30000ms, 'renderer may be frozen or unresponsive'). A javascript_tool DOM check on one frozen tab confirmed 0 <input> elements were receiving the typed text (fields remained empty in every verified screenshot taken before each freeze). This appears to be a site-specific rendering issue on zenrows.com/partners/apply that is not resolved by opening a new tab, resizing the window, using Tab-key navigation instead of raw clicks, or typing single characters instead of full strings - the freeze occurs immediately upon the first keystroke into the Name field on every attempt.
left_blank_for_human: How do you want to partner with us? (select Affiliate)
I agree to allow ZenRows to store and process my personal data (required checkbox - left unchecked per the standing rule against checking legal/consent checkboxes)

error: Persistent renderer freeze (CDP screenshot timeout) triggered by any keyboard input into the Name field on zenrows.com/partners/apply, reproduced across 3 fresh tabs; no form data could be entered by automation.
note_on_fit: This is NOT a password/legal/CAPTCHA/OTP block - it is a technical browser-automation failure specific to this page (reproducible renderer freeze on keystroke). The form itself requires no password and would otherwise be fully within butler scope. Suggested values for manual completion: Name='Sangkwon', Last Name='An', Work Email='support@coshuma.com', Website='https://coshuma.com', Partner type='Affiliate'. The required 'store and process my personal data' consent checkbox was intentionally left unchecked for human review, consistent with the standing rule that the butler never checks legal/consent checkboxes.
